name: Widgets: Clock, Weather & Notes
summary:
Widgets brings the familiar phone-widget category to Horizon OS as live 2D windows. Open the gallery, pick a widget, and spawn it as a floating window anywhere in your workspace — then arrange as many as you like around your rooms.

Time & date — Clock, Date, Countdown, World Clock, Timer, Time Converter and Stopwatch keep you on schedule.
Productivity — a full Calculator, Pomodoro, Time Tracker, Water intake, Tasks and Unit Converter help you get things done.
Info & media — live Weather, News (any RSS feed
